protocol.case_bootstrap: Paired per-case success differences; sample 50 cases with replacement within each prespecified suite; percentile 2.5/97.5 intervals
protocol.task_cluster_bootstrap: Sample ten tasks with replacement, retaining each selected task's five paired initial states; percentile 2.5/97.5 intervals
protocol.seed: SHA256(manifest hash, frozen suite/better/worse, method); independent of observed outcomes
protocol.primary_tests: One-sided exact conditional McNemar for each frozen better>worse direction; Holm-adjusted across exactly two hypotheses
protocol.stability: Positive paired difference, both bootstrap lower bounds >0, and positive leave-one-task-out and leave-one-init-out differences
protocol.interpretation: Support complementarity only when both frozen directions meet stability; otherwise distinguish positive directions with uncertainty from directions not reproduced. No single p threshold determines the conclusion.
protocol.caveats: Ten task clusters and five initial states limit precision; bootstrap intervals are approximate. Non-significance is not equivalence. Other categories are descriptive; no path or suite reselection.
